{{Quote|Those GAS guys are starting to get pushy.|Baxton|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Baxton''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|driver]] of [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]'s [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]]. In [[43 ABY]], he traveled with Fel to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the [[Unification Summit]] among the three prevalent [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] governments. Later, Baxton was present during Fel's capture of [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] and [[Bazel Warv]], after which he was confronted by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]]. Fel, however, used his diplomatic immunity to convince Atar to let Baxton go, and they left the scene in his limousine with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. Atar, frustrated, ordered an [[Galactic Alliance Security assault speeder|assault speeder]] to block their exit. Fel told Baxton to ask the [[Unidentified Duros lieutenant|speeder's commander]] to let them pass, but the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] refused to move his speeder. Baxton got into a heated argument with the officer, but Fel, again using his diplomatic immunity, was able to force Atar to order the Security troops to move, and Baxton drove them away.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I can just float over them, sir. Even if they open fire, our armor can take it.|Baxton, to Jagged Fel|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Jagged_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Imperial Head of State Jagged Fel]]
Baxton was a big-shouldered [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served under [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. In [[43 ABY]], he traveled with Fel to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Abyss" /> for the [[Unification Summit]], a series of negotiations attempting to unite the Imperial Remnant, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], and the [[Confederation]].<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> There, Baxton served as the [[Pilot/Legends|driver]] of Fel's [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]], an exceptionally long and heavily [[Armor/Legends|armored]] luxury [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]]. Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] began to develop a [[Force psychosis|mysterious psychosis]] that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors,<ref name="Abyss" /> and the Galactic Alliance [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to deal with the issue by [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encasing]] the affected Knights in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="Outcast" />

Baxton was present in 43.5 ABY when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] developed the psychosis. They were quickly incapacitated by Fel, Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and her parents, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], outside the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|speeder entrance]]. Warv, who was hit by [[Tranquilizer dart/Legends|tranquilizer darts]], fell onto Fel's limousine, severely denting the roof. Fel ordered Baxton to stay quiet about the incident, and while Han, Jaina, and the Head of State hid Saav'etu and Warv inside the Jedi Temple, Organa Solo and Baxton remained out by the limousine. There, they were accosted by a [[Galactic Alliance Security]] assault [[Squad/Legends|squad]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]], who ordered several of his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to surround the limousine while four more held Baxton at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]]. Atar confronted Organa Solo, who denied any knowledge of the situation. When Fel, Han, and Jaina returned, the Imperial Head of State quickly ordered Atar to have his men stand down. The captain, fearing that he would evoke a diplomatic incident, complied, ordering his men to release Baxton and the limousine. Atar then requested that the Solos hand over Warv and Saav'etu, and when he showed them a warrant for the arrest of the two psychotic Jedi, Han and Leia decided to stall for time by reentering the Temple and closing the gate behind them. Fel and Jaina then got into the limousine and Baxton drove them away.<ref name="Abyss" />

Atar, frustrated at having failed to capture the Jedi, ordered a [[Unidentified Duros lieutenant|Duros lieutenant]] to prevent the limousine from leaving. Their exit was cut off by the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant's]] forces in a [[Galactic Alliance Security assault speeder]], and Baxton suggested to Fel that they just float over them. Fel, however, told him to simply ask the Security troops to let them go by. Baxton got out and confronted the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]], requesting that he let them pass. The officer, however, refused to move his speeder, and the two quickly got into a heated argument. [[Journalist/Legends|Journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] soon arrived, and it was then discovered that he had been using a [[Lovolol cleaning droid]] to infiltrate the Temple for his weekly show, ''[[Javis Tyrr Presents: The Jedi Among Us]]''. As Baxton and the Duros officer continued to argue, Atar also arrived and reassured Fel and Solo that Tyrr wouldn't do anything illegal. Fel then requested that they be allowed to leave, but Atar insisted that the Head of State first hand over Solo and the cleaning droid. Fel, however, called Baxton back over to the limousine as Solo reminded Atar of Fel's diplomatic immunity, revealing that as the cleaning droid was now in the limousine it had become Imperial property. Forced to comply, Atar ordered the Duros to move the assault speeder, and Baxton drove the limousine away.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|As far as GAS is concerned, I didn't see anything.''"<br />"''Lying to a GAS agent is a crime here. Just tell them you're not authorized to discuss my activities with anyone. That's well within your immunity and rights, and you won't run the risk of arrest.''"<br />"''Thank you for considering my welfare, sir.|Baxton and Jagged Fel|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Baxton was very loyal to Fel; he was willing to illegally lie to a Galactic Alliance Security officer in the interest of protecting his Head of State. Later, when the Duros lieutenant refused to move his speeder to let them pass, Baxton quickly became aggravated and argued extensively with the officer.<ref name="Abyss" />

Baxton was a professional driver for the Imperial Remnant; he traveled with the Imperial embassy to Coruscant to drive Fel's personal limousine during the Head of State's stay there. Baxton was confident in his driving skills as well as the limousine's durability, suggesting to Fel that they simply float over the assault speeder, as he believed that their armor could withstand the speeder's [[Laser/Legends|fire]]. Baxton also carried a [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]].<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baxton's first appeared in [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third of nine novels in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
